title: Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings
abstract: arXiv:2610.01827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. translated_title: 验证拥塞下基于多保真度成对排序的科学发现
translated_abstract: 现代计算方法如今能够以前所未有的规模提出候选分子、材料及其他科学设计，由此产生了“验证拥塞”现象：候选设计大量涌现，而用于实际评估它们的实验能力却依然稀缺。因此，发现新颖的科学设计越来越依赖于筛选：挑选出一小批有前景的设计，交给缓慢而昂贵的实验进行验证。现有的筛选方法通常依赖预测绝对分数的数据驱动回归模型，但训练这类模型一开始就需要大量实验数据。然而，有用的筛选信号并不一定要以绝对测量的形式呈现，因为科学设计的发现过程在本质上往往是比较性的。在此，我们提出筛选可以主要由专家成对排序来驱动，而这类排序要容易收集得多。这些专业知识可以来自计算工具……（摘要在此处被截断，原文不完整）
tldr: 该论文针对候选设计过剩而实验资源稀缺的“验证拥塞”问题，提出用远比绝对测量更容易收集的多保真度专家成对排序来驱动科学设计筛选，从而摆脱对大量实验数据训练回归模型的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes driving the curation of scientific designs with multi-fidelity expert pairwise rankings—which are much easier to collect than absolute measurements—to overcome validation congestion where abundant candidates outpace scarce experimental capacity.
